answer: A sybil ring collapses the moment it meets a honeypot audit: the registry plants decoy reputation grants on hollow accounts that no honest operator would ever touch, and any claim drawn from one is proof of farming. Each identity must post a renewable bond, and a hit on a decoy slashes the full deposit instantly. The economics bite hardest at the nadir, when bonds are cheapest to stack, and again at the zenith of a payout cycle, when attackers are most tempted to cash out.
